description: This file defines platform-specific upgrade functions for a Linux-based firmware, including a check image function and a do upgrade function that handles different board types.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that checks the firmware image, currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process based on the board name, handling specific boards with nand_do_upgrade and others with default_do_upgrade.
